representativeTask.title: OpenClaw agent: implement and verify a code edit
representativeTask.description: The pinned OpenClaw runtime (openclaw/openclaw, revision f6883b3771c0a40d7bd62fcb99815dcbbb2e24f3, "OpenClaw 2026.9.7 (f6883b3)") solves a real coding task headless — implementing a documented function through its file and terminal tools, running the verification itself — with Zeck as its sole AI execution authority: every model turn rides the delegated agent-loop seam through the multi-surface delegation boundary, and the same boundary carries the vision, speech-recognition, speech-generation and image-generation surfaces the corpus proves.

reproducibility.instructions: Prepare the pinned checkout: git clone https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw.git && git -C openclaw checkout f6883b3771c0a40d7bd62fcb99815dcbbb2e24f3 at /home/z/openclaw-upstream, then pnpm install --ignore-scripts (pnpm@12.5.1). Build the compiled runtime: bun run compat/openclaw/harness/build-compiled-runtime.ts — it never writes onto a git-tracked path (the pinned tree's own 42 checked-in shims/artifacts are skipped), compiles every .ts/.mts under src/, packages/*/src/ and scripts/ to in-place .js/.mjs siblings with the checkout's own esbuild, rewrites literal .ts/.mts import specifiers to their compiled forms, re-injects `with { type: "json" }` import attributes esbuild drops, mirrors each package's compiled src to dist/*.mjs, closes every package's export map (dist-internal links for the repo's tsdown utils-flattening; generated shim packages under .zeck-build/shims for source-.ts export maps, with the root node_modules/@openclaw links repointed), and stages the ROOT deploy surface the runtime's own resolution needs: dist/*.js links of the compiled src siblings for the root package's self-referenced openclaw/plugin-sdk/* exports, plus the built-form bundled extensions (extensions/.zeck-bundled/openai + browser — compiled entries with openclaw.runtimeExtensions, real-file manifests, an openclaw alias package over dist/plugin-sdk) selected through the app's documented OPENCLAW_BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR axis so only the two staged plugins load as compiled JavaScript (no source-tree capture, no tsx loader). The builder writes compiled-runtime.manifest.json and its verify mode proves byte-identity. Then build the corpus assets: bun run compat/openclaw/harness/build-corpus-assets.ts (the vision swatch is deterministic local synthesis; the voice-memo fixture is one quota-lawed TTS round-trip through the delegated chain). Then run the battery: bun run compat/openclaw/harness/run-battery.ts (resumable; every step checkpoints to /tmp/ppr-023-battery/battery-state.json). The battery requires the sandbox's authorized GLM supply config (/etc/.z-ai-config) — platform-side BYOK material, never present in the OpenClaw runtime — and the sandbox's Playwright Chromium for the browser task (browser.executablePath, the app's own config axis).
